meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
Bharat mein under 3000 rupees budget ke andar running shoes ke liye kayi behtareen options available hain, jo achha cushioning, grip aur durability dete hain.

Aapke budget ke hisaab se kuch best running shoes ki list neeche di gayi hai:

---

### Best Running Shoes Under 3000 in India (2026)

| Brand & Model | Approx. Price | Best For | Key Features |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Campus OGs / Active Series** | ₹1,500 - ₹2,500 | Daily Jogging & Casual Run | Lightweight, breathable mesh upper, good shock absorption. |
| **Sparx Running Shoes (SX Series)** | ₹1,000 - ₹2,000 | Budget-friendly regular use | Durable outsole, firm grip, highly budget-friendly. |
| **Asian Nitro / Wonder Series** | ₹1,200 - ₹2,200 | Value for money | Memory foam tech, flexible sole, attractive design. |
| **Red Tape Sports Shoes** | ₹1,500 - ₹2,800 | All-rounder & Gym/Run | Sturdy build, comfortable inner cushioning, stylish look. |
| **Puma (Entry-level models like Scuff or Electrify)** | ₹2,200 - ₹3,000 (on sale) | Brand reliability | Better durability, superior ankle support, premium finish. |

---

### Kuch Zaroori Baatein (Tips for Buying):

* **Sale ka Fayda Lein:** Amazon aur Myntra jaisi sites par aksar sales chalti hain, jisme Puma ya Bata ke entry-level running shoes aapko ₹2500-₹3000 ki range mein mil jayenge.
* **Size Selection:** Running shoes hamesha apne regular shoe size se **ek size (half ya one size) bada** kharidein, kyunki daudte waqt pair thode phoolte hain.
* **Usage:** Agar aap sirf morning walk ya light jogging karte hain, toh Sparx ya Asian best hain. Agar aap regular running ya treadmill use ke liye le rahe hain, toh Campus ya Puma ke options prefer karein.
